prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a starter pet to join you on your desktop."]
1: ["Preparing Your Custom Pet", "We will craft your desktop pet based on your choices.", "Let us create your magic companion!"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active! Click and drag to position it anywhere on your desktop."]
3: ["Save Your Pet Choice", "Sign in to save your new companion to your account so it is never lost."]
4: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Generating pet animations and preparing desktop environment."]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Log in to access your existing pets or sync your new companion across devices."]
6: ["Don't worry! You can switch or add paths anytime in settings later."]
7: ["Step 3 of 4: Adoption Certificate Ready!"]
8: ["Enable notifications to know the instant your pet is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Right click your pet to open actions, drag to move, or use the system tray to manage settings.", "Right-click: Talk & Actions | Drag: Move Pet | System Tray: Hide/Settings"]
